_doc: Data-driven inventory for the STACK dashboard (config-level, not just high-level): which repo dirs exist, which env vars are set (grouped, presence only — never the values), which tools/GUI apps resolve + their version, and static architecture facts (multi-OS layout, bootloader, builders). Add entries here, not in main.rs.

flakes.name: cloud-infra
flakes.role: Service infra — Nix flakes → Docker Compose, 60+ services on 5 VMs

flakes.name: cloud-unix
flakes.role: NixOS host + home-manager (desktop, termux, builders, per-VM)

flakes.name: cloud-vault
flakes.role: All credentials — sops + age + OAuth + SSH/WG/TOTP

flakes.name: cloud-mykonsole-dtk
flakes.role: Cross-repo tooling (consumed as submodule from cloud/unix/front)

multi_os.label: NixOS (primary)
multi_os.detail: Surface Pro 8 · LUKS + USB keyfile · linux-surface kernel · btrfs subvolumes · impermanence (root=tmpfs)

multi_os.label: Windows (webcam-only)
multi_os.detail: ESP chainload, dedicated to webcam driver support only

multi_os.label: Shared-Lib (p5)
multi_os.detail: ext4 → /mnt/shared-lib, Docker/Podman data-root, shared across boots

multi_os.label: Ventoy USB
multi_os.detail: LUKS keyfile + multi-OS live boot media

bootloader.label: rEFInd
bootloader.detail: Primary boot manager (UEFI) — owns all bootloader management; NixOS yields to it

builders.label: cloud-builder-x
builders.detail: Multi-arch (QEMU) builder image, runs on oci-apps

builders.label: forge
builders.detail: x86 cache builder, 52GB cache on GHCR
